verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage is a SaaS compliance platform that ships AI agents for screening and transaction monitoring, so an AI-training opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence pack contains no documentation of a training opt-out, a data-usage policy, or any control preventing customer data from being used to train models. The AI agent pages describe capabilities, not data-use controls, and do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
